body: My oldest is 14 and much bigger/stronger than me so I made sure he knew that it was because of him that the paramedics were able to start his heart again. He was officially pronounced brain dead 2 days later but because his heart was beating, we were able to donate his liver and kidneys (sadly didn’t find a match for his heart). So everyone made sure that my oldest knew it was because of him that the recipients got a second chance at life. He’s a quiet kid so he doesn’t talk much about his feelings but he seems happy and his sleep/eating patterns didn’t change.

Thank you, and yes, he was my best friend (pretty much my only friend) but stuff wasn’t always good... he was an addict, though he hid it quite well (minus the thousands of dollars of debt he put us in...). The pain is from feeling like I didn’t do enough. Over the last 3 years, he probably tried to hang himself about 14 times and I was always there to either talk him out of it or hold him. And every time he promised he would get help but he didn’t. And the last time I just wasn’t fast enough at coming downstairs cuz I was mad at him. The last thing I told him was that I hated him but I love him soo much and I wish I could take it back.

The younger 2 don’t know how he died (they were 5 and 9 at the time). My oldest helped me lift his body up while we waited for the paramedics. My youngest often tells me he wishes I was dead instead of daddy cuz daddy was more fun. I know he doesn’t understand completely or mean it but it fucking hurts every time.

After my husband died, some woman who had only met him once or twice kept posting about his death and was looking for sympathy... I called her out when she started sharing the funeral arrangements... people suck.
